title: citation-census@1 output line
description: One JSON object per output line, exactly one per item label, in the order given. The validator parses leniently, one repair pass re-asks for missing labels, and an entry without a parseable line after repair is an invalid output.

l.description: the value after id=, copied exactly

c.description: T supported, F not supported, N not assessable, U cited work not identifiable

q.description: verbatim excerpt of the cited work for F; empty otherwise
